scripts.pack:build: cd city-pack && python3 -m lore_citypack build --city rome --seed data/rome_seed.json --out output && python3 -m lore_citypack build --city mumbai --seed data/mumbai_seed.json --out output && node ../scripts/copy-pack.mjs
